clips.send: A dad sends this to his wife before their next grocery run - anger that something flagged as safe for decades needed a ban to say otherwise.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to brominated vegetable oil, an additive the FDA called "safe and effective" for decades before moving to ban it - research he cites links it to nervous system effects, headaches and lower testosterone.

His view: it stayed legal for years in sodas and food products while the companies making money from it fought to keep it that way.

It's worth a look at your own pantry - it shows up on labels as "brominated vegetable oil."

Have you ever actually read your soda's ingredient label?

#kevintrudeau #foodlabels #sodaingredients #fdawatch #cleaneating #wbdaily

clips.send: A mom sends this to her sister before their weekly grocery list - anxiety about which produce to actually buy organic.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau turns to pesticides: conventional fruits and vegetables grown in the US, he says, are routinely treated with pesticides, herbicides and fungicides that stay on the produce you bring home.

His practical point: it's not about skipping fruits and vegetables - it's about knowing which ones are worth buying organic. Green beans, he points out, are one of the riskier conventional picks.

His simple fix: buy organic where you can, and wash what you can't.

Which vegetable in your fridge would you switch to organic first?
